title: Returning `impl Fn(T) -> impl Trait` does not compile, unless you add an `identity` call
body:
I tried this code: ```rust #![feature(impl_trait_in_fn_trait_return)] #![feature(unboxed_closures)] // only for `h` use std::fmt::Debug; // Fails?? fn f() -> impl Fn(T) -> impl Debug { |_x| 15 } // Works?... fn g() -> impl MyFn<(T,), Out = impl Debug> { |_x| 15 } trait MyFn { type Out; } impl U> MyFn<(T,)> for F { type Out = U; } // Also fails?? fn h() -> impl Fn<(T,), Output = impl Debug> { |_x| 15 } // Works?????? fn f_() -> impl Fn(T) -> impl Debug { std::convert::identity(|_x| 15) } // Works????? fn f__() -> impl Fn(T) -> impl Debug { let r = |_x| 15; r } ``` [[play]](https://play.rust-lang.org/?version=nightly&mode=debug&edition=2021&gist=23709b2eab5c6c9e82ab5619f64295af) I expected to see this happen: all of the above functions successfully compile. Instead, this happened: `f` and `h` do not compile for no clear reason, while `g`, `f_` and `f__` do compile, even though they are all almost identical.
Compiler output

``` error: concrete type differs from previous defining opaque type use --> src/lib.rs:8:10 | 8 | |_x| 15 | ^^ expected `impl Debug`, got `i32` | note: previous use here --> src/lib.rs:8:5 | 8 | |_x| 15 | ^^^^^^^ error[[E0720]](https://doc.rust-lang.org/nightly/error-index.html#E0720): cannot resolve opaque type --> src/lib.rs:7:28 | 7 | fn f() -> impl Fn(T) -> impl Debug { | ^^^^^^^^^^ cannot resolve opaque type error: concrete type differs from previous defining opaque type use --> src/lib.rs:21:10 | 21 | |_x| 15 | ^^ expected `impl Debug`, got `i32` | note: previous use here --> src/lib.rs:21:5 | 21 | |_x| 15 | ^^^^^^^ error[[E0720]](https://doc.rust-lang.org/nightly/error-index.html#E0720): cannot resolve opaque type --> src/lib.rs:20:37 | 20 | fn h() -> impl Fn<(T,), Output = impl Debug> { | ^^^^^^^^^^ cannot resolve opaque type ```

### Meta Rustc version: ``` 1.69.0-nightly (2023-02-09 8996ea93b6e554148c42) ```
